summary: WPP plc filed a Form 6-K, the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report, on October 2, 2026, furnishing a Notification of Major Holdings under UK Disclosure and Transparency Rules rather than announcing a transaction. The excerpt discloses no stake percentage, price per share, consideration, premium, advisor, or closing date, only identifying the registrant and its London address plus blanket forward-looking-statement boilerplate. Because the filing is a routine shareholder-interest notification, it does not constitute an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, strategic review, or other special situation; no deal terms are stated.
